Glenn Rane (A.K.A. Raneman) was a Principal Artist on the World of Warcraft team at Blizzard Entertainment and Art Lead for Hearthstone. He is also the "Fifth Son" of Sons of the Storm. Having worked in the video game industry for over 15 years, his artwork and art direction represent all of Blizzard's games on magazines, book covers, game box covers, web banners, logos, concept art, merchandise, loading screens, at conventions, and in other high profile places. Glenn has created iconic character designs and artwork for Warcraft, Starcraft, Diablo, Hearthstone, WoW TCG, BlizzCon and licensed products during his tenure at Blizzard, and has also done work for other MMORPGs and video games such

Glenn Stafford was a Principal Composer for Blizzard Entertainment and the founder of the Blizzard Sound Department. He was Audio Director of Blizzard from 1993 to 2005. Derek Duke, Jason Hayes and him were the original music team for StarCraft. Glenn has touched every iteration of WarCraft since Warcraft: Orcs & Humans. His other game projects at Blizzard include The Lost Vikings franchise, Blackthorne, cinematic music of Diablo and Diablo II, Starcraft II, Diablo III, and Heroes of the Storm. After over 30 years of working at Blizzard Entertainment, Glenn left the company in July of 2024, though no announcement was made.

The Gleaming Crane Statue is found on the last leg of the Firewalkers' Path before the broken bridge high above the Red Stone Run on the eastern side of the Timeless Isle. Interacting with the crane will cause it to launch adventurers high up into the air with a slow fall buff. There are a number of floating Mist-Covered Treasure Chests that can be interacted with on the way down -- all contain a decent amount of Timeless Coins. As with the Gleaming Treasure Chest and Rope-Bound Treasure Chest, this can only be done once a week.

Gleaming Treasure Satchel is a bag hanging off the boom of the unnamed floating pirate ship off the coast of the Croaking Hollow. It may be opened once each week. Scare it off and it'll sometimes leave a Glimmerfin Scale on the ground, which starts this quest.

Glory of the Hero is a meta dungeon & raids achievement earned for the completion a set of heroic dungeon achievements in Northrend instances. There are at least two achievements for every Northrend 5-man instance. Trial of the Champion and the Icecrown Citadel instances have similar achievements, but do not count towards Glory of the Hero. This achievement will reward you with the Reins of the Red Proto-Drake.

The Gloves of Glistening Runes drop from Keristrasza in the Nexus on heroic mode. These gloves are in some ways a memorial to Keristrasza, a red dragon who was imprisoned by Malygos when she refused to bow to him. After she was released from the arcane prison he locked her in, she continued the fight against him in the Nexus War and lured Saragosa, Malygos’s consort, to her death. In vengeance, Malygos forced Keristrasza to be his new consort. He tormented her and branded her body with runes—like those on these gloves— until she went madder than him. The only escape for her after that was death.

Gloves of Journey's End is a quest reward from Journey's End (quest).
Gloves of Delicate Mixture is a quest reward from Fuel-ology 101 and The Perfect Fuel.
The Glopgut's Hollow is a subzone of the Twilight Highlands. It is a sizable ogre fortress under control of the Glopgut, complete with a mound, several towers and a wall surrounding the area.
Gloomwings are black drakes found consuming Keeland Doyle and his group in the Twilight Highlands.
Gloves of Aetherial Rumor are a reputation reward; you must be with Wildhammer Clan to purchase this item from Craw MacGraw in Twilight Highlands for .
The Glittering Epidermis drops from the Ascendant Council in the Bastion of Twilight.

Glory of the Cataclysm Hero is a meta dungeon & raids achievement earned for the completion a set of heroic dungeon achievements in Cataclysm instances. There is at least one achievement for every Cataclysm 5-man instance. This achievement will also reward you with the Reins of the Volcanic Stone Drake.
Gloves of Baleflame are a quest reward from Closing a Dark Chapter.

Glory of the Lich King Raider is a meta-achievement awarded to players in a guild group for completing the 8 Wrath of the Lich King 10 to 25-man normal or heroic raids located in Northrend: *Naxxramas *Eye of Eternity *Ulduar *Trial of the Crusader or Trial of the Grand Crusader *Icecrown Citadel *Ruby Sanctum
Glorious! is an exploration achievement earned for defeating each and every one of the champions found wandering Pandaria.
Glory of the Pandaria Hero is a meta dungeon & raids achievement earned for the completion a set of heroic dungeon achievements in Mists of Pandaria instances.
Gloves of Earthen Harmony are crafted with Leatherworking (600); taught by Pattern: Gloves of Earthen Harmony, a Golden Lotus reputation reward.
__NOTOC__ Glintrok Hexxers are saurok seen watching over the Vault of Kings Past in Mogu'shan Palace.

__NOTOC__ Glintrok Ironhides are saurok found in the Forgotten Passageway of the Mogu'shan Palace. They're alerted by a Glintrok Scout that a player is nearby and goes down along with the Glintrok Greenhorns to protect block the stairway.
__NOTOC__ Glintrok Oracles are orange saurok located in the Vault of Kings Past of the Mogu'shan Palace. They're seen looking over the vault.
__NOTOC__ Glintrok Skulkers are saurok who patrol the Forgotten Passageway in Mogu'shan Palace and are also in the fight with Gekkan in the Vault of Kings Past.

Glintronk Greenhorns are saurok located in the Forgotten Passageway of the Mogu'shan Palace. They block a set of stairs along with the Glintrok Ironhide. They are warned by a Glintrok Scout if it detects players. They're also seen in the Vault of Kings Past watching over them.
Glintrok Pillagers are red saurok who carry treasures filled with gold to the other side of the cave in the Forgotten Passageway over the bridge.

Glintrok Scouts are saurok found in the Forgotten Passageway of the Mogu'shan Palace. They are first seen carrying a treasure at the end of the Trial of the King, then they go back to the staircase. They alert the Glintrok Ironhide and Glintrok Greenhorns to block the stairways against players.

The Glorious Standard of the Kirin Tor Offensive is a quest reward from Securing A Future, offered by Lady Jaina Proudmoore on the Violet Rise upon reaching standing with the Kirin Tor Offensive. Use the provided Staff of Antonidas on Lei Shen's dais in the Pinnacle of Storms of the Throne of Thunder to charge it, becoming the Storm-Stave of Antonidas.

Glory of the Pandaria Raider is a meta dungeon & raids achievement earned for completing the listed Pandaria achievements. The achievement also rewards the Reins of the Heavenly Crimson Cloud Serpent.
The Glorious Standard of the Sunreaver Onslaught is rewarded from Life Blood.

The Glintrok are a raiding party of saurok that have taken the opportunity to loot and plunder while the mogu clan leaders squabble in Mogu'shan Palace. They appear to be more honorable than usual saurok, as their leader Gekkan is said to inspire courage and loyalty in them. The :Glintrok Sollerets are named after them.
Glintrok N' Roll is an achievement awarded for defeating and his minions within 5 minutes of aggroing the in Mogu'shan Palace on Heroic difficulty.
Piles of Glinting Sand are found all over the beaches of Timeless Isle.
Glint is a rare shale spider that can be found at the Circle of Inner Binding in the Arathi Highlands.
Globs of Sticky Tar drops from Black Tars for the quest Tar Get of Opportunity.
Gloria's Glorious Gliding Goodies were never made available.
Glory of the Draenor Raider is a meta dungeon & raids achievement earned for completing the listed achievements. The achievement also rewards an epic ground mount, the Gorestrider Gronnling.
